clientOrg.description: The name of the client organization

clientMemberId.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

name.description: The name of the client organization

id.description: UUID of the client organization's FBO account

availableAmount.description: Available balance to spend for the account

balanceAmount.description: Settled transaction balance for the account

lastFourAccountNumber.description: The last four digits of the bank account number

routingNumber.description: The account routing number (9 Digits, numeric)

verifiedDate.description: Date when the account was verified

verifiedIndicator.description: Flag that represents the state of verification of an account

updateDate.description: Last known date when the balance was last updated

incentiveRatio.description: The number that is multiplied by the cash deposit value to determine the incentive value

incentiveValue.description: Virtual currency balance of the incentive account based on the incentive ratio

creationDate.description: Date when the account was created

effectiveDate.description: Date when the account becomes effective for the member

expirationDate.description: Date when the account expires for the member

nextScheduledFundsLoadDate.description: Date when the next scheduled funding will occur for the account
